name: Hiiragi Eriko
source:
She is a mother who loves her only son, Yoshiya, more than anything else.
She is bright, energetic, and unusually young, and although she is even seen as a younger sister rather than a mother, she herself believes herself to be a decent woman full of adult charm.


[From [url=http://www.light.gr.jp/light/products/ssg_cs/character/top01.html]Official Website[/url]]
